_info: Original English voice lines for Rogue Commanders (written for this mod, not quotes), rendered offline with Piper using public-domain/CC0/CC-BY voices (see VOICES.md). Events: select, run_start, battle, boss, commander, victory, defeat, package, record. Own clips can be added to _mods/rogue-commanders/voices/<slug>/<event>_*.wav|ogg|mp3 Incremental events: death and boss_<deck id>. Original mod dialogue; no actor audio used.

select: You chose well. Do try to keep up.
Very well. I shall lend you my aether. For now.
run_start: Patience and precision. Let us begin.
The aether stirs. Our path lies ahead.
battle: Your aether betrays your every intention.
One spell is enough, if it is the right one.
Spare me the theatrics and draw.
boss: Such a heavy presence. How very tiresome.
I have faced gods before. You are hardly a concern.
victory: As I expected. Shall we move on?
Next time, think before you act.
defeat: Hmph. A lesson, then. I shall not forget it.
I misread the currents. It will not happen twice.
record: A new record. I would expect nothing less of us.

select: Everything that falls returns. Choose me, and see.
The scale tips toward you. For now.
run_start: Balance demands a price. Let it be paid in full.
Life feeds death, and death feeds me. Begin.
battle: Your end will nourish my beginning.
The graveyard is merely another treasury.
Everything you discard, I shall keep.
boss: A great shadow. It too will become dust.
Weigh yourself against me. You will be found wanting.
commander: I rise from what was lost.
The scale is set. Behold its keeper.
victory: Rest now. Your bones will serve me well.
All things end. Yours came early.
defeat: Even the scale must sometimes tip. I will return.
Death is only a pause. Remember that.
package: More to give. More to take.
record: A new record. The scale remembers everything.

select: Of course you chose me. Anything else would have been a mistake.
Good. Now try not to disappoint me.
run_start: I don't lose. Let's remind everyone why.
Bow, or burn. Those are the only choices they get.
battle: This won't take long.
Look at you. Trembling already.
Kneel, and maybe I'll make it quick.
boss: So you think you're a threat? How adorable.
Finally. Someone worth burning.
commander: Watch closely. This is what perfection looks like.
victory: Did you really think you stood a chance?
defeat: This was not part of the plan!
No. I do not lose. Again!
record: A new record. Naturally. I was always the best.
death: You will regret... seeing me fall.
boss_b5-dino: A large beast is still a beast. Kneel.
boss_b5-equip: Pretty weapons, Nahiri. Let us test their melting point.
boss_b5-dragon-fixed: Ancient dragon. Show me a flame worth respecting.
boss_b10-vamp: Sorin. Your bloodline ends at my feet.
boss_b10-control: Keep your clever tricks, Teferi. I need one opening.
boss_b10-dragon: Lathliss. There is room for only one queen of fire.
boss_final-chandra: Chandra. Let me show you what disciplined fire can do.
boss_final-sliver: A whole hive, and not one of you fit to rule.
boss_b15-emrakul: You will not crawl inside my head, monster.
boss_b15-chandra: Chandra. Let me show you what disciplined fire can do.
boss_b15-sliver: A whole hive, and not one of you fit to rule.
boss_final-emrakul: You will not crawl inside my head, monster.

select: Fine. I'll take the job. Just don't expect speeches.
You wanted a mercenary. You've got one.
run_start: Let's get this over with.
Fifteen fights. I've had worse contracts.
battle: Nothing personal.
Let's see what you've got.
Stay out of my way.
boss: Big one. Doesn't matter.
I've cut down bigger than you.
defeat: Tch. Guess I wasn't ready.
I'll get it right next time.
record: New record. Guess I'm still the best around.

select: I slept through ages. Do not wake me for nothing.
My story is still unwritten. Let us write it.
run_start: The dragonstorms are calling. We answer.
Spread your wings. The hunt begins.
battle: Do you hear the roar beyond the horizon?
My brood is hungry.
The sky belongs to dragons.
boss: A rival in the sky. Only one of us will fly.
Ancient as you are, I am older.
victory: Another tale my brood will tell.
defeat: Even dragons fall. Not forever.
The storm will rise again.
record: A new record. Write it in fire across the sky.

select: Let's light this up.
No more hiding. Let's go.
run_start: Okay, Runaways. Time to fight back.
Stay behind me. I've got this.
battle: Time to shine.
You picked the wrong girl to fight.
Let's see how you handle the light.
boss: Big, scary, and about to get blinded.
Everyone, cover your eyes!
defeat: Okay... that one hurt.
We regroup. We always regroup.
record: We did it! The Runaways are legends now!
death: Keep going... I still believe in you.

select: [dinosaur roar]
[dinosaur roar]
run_start: [dinosaur roar]
[dinosaur roar]
battle: [dinosaur roar]
[dinosaur roar]
[dinosaur roar]
boss: [dinosaur roar]
[dinosaur roar]
defeat: [pained dinosaur growl]
[pained dinosaur growl]

select: I already knew you'd pick me.
Good choice. I'd have made the same one. I did, actually.
run_start: Every match is a puzzle. Let's solve it.
I've mapped all fifteen fights. Fourteen go perfectly.
battle: I know your cards before you draw them.
Think before you act. I already have.
Your plan is cute. Mine is better.
boss: Interesting. A mind I haven't mapped yet.
Big, loud and predictable. My favourite kind.
commander: Let me rearrange the multiverse a little.
Everything is going according to plan.
defeat: That was not in any of my projections.
A variable I missed. It won't happen again.
boss_b5-dino: All that strength. One predictable thought.
boss_b5-equip: Nahiri. A blade cannot cut an illusion.
boss_b5-dragon-fixed: Ancient wings. Let us try a new idea.
boss_b10-vamp: Sorin. Even old minds have blind spots.
boss_b10-control: Teferi. You can delay the inevitable.
boss_b10-dragon: Lathliss. A brood shares more than blood.
boss_final-chandra: Chandra. Please think before you burn the plan.
boss_final-sliver: One shared mind. One point of failure.
boss_b15-emrakul: That mind... no. Find the edge. Hold it.
boss_b15-chandra: Chandra. Please think before you burn the plan.
boss_b15-sliver: One shared mind. One point of failure.
boss_final-emrakul: That mind... no. Find the edge. Hold it.

select: I have seen what is to come.
The light chose you. Follow it.
run_start: The radiation whispers. Follow it.
The path glows ahead. Walk it with me.
battle: Your mind will melt.
I saw your downfall. Yesterday.
Look into the light.
boss: A great darkness. How wonderful.
Even giants are moths before the flame.
defeat: This, too, I foresaw.
The light flickers. It never dies.
record: A new record. The prophecy grows brighter.

select: Discipline over pride. Let's begin.
You chose a student of the open hand. Good.
run_start: Breathe. Focus. Then strike.
Fifteen rounds. One step at a time.
battle: Show me your stance.
Calm mind, fast hands.
I won't strike first. But I will strike last.
boss: Strength like yours needs balance. Let me teach you.
The bigger they are, the harder they fall.
commander: Watch the flow. Then it's over.
defeat: A master is a student who never stops learning.
I'll train harder. Next time.
record: A new record. My teachers would be proud.

select: A useful alliance. Let us discuss the terms.
run_start: Every debt in this tower has an owner.
battle: Nothing is wasted. Not even your resistance.
boss: A formidable estate. I shall acquire it.
commander: The family has taken an interest.
victory: A clean settlement. Collect what we are owed.
defeat: An unfortunate expense. I shall recover it.
package: Select carefully. Every asset has its purpose.
record: An excellent return. Have it entered in the ledger.

select: Give me the pieces. I will make them work.
run_start: This tower has a heart. Let us see how it works.
battle: Every machine has a weakness. Yours is showing.
boss: A powerful design. There must be a fault.
commander: Systems ready. Put the engines to work.
victory: Efficient. Salvage what we can use.
defeat: The design needs work. I am not finished.
record: Better than the last design. Keep the results.

select: Come closer, dear. We shall make a lovely pair.
run_start: Such a lonely tower. Let us bring it a little charm.
battle: You need not struggle. Let me take care of you.
boss: Even the proudest heart can be persuaded.
commander: There now. You feel better already.
victory: How sweet. You finally know your place.
defeat: An unpleasant surprise. This is not over.
package: Choose something lovely. Beauty has its uses.
record: A happy ending. For us, at least.

select: I will walk this road beside you.
run_start: We go with courage, and with care.
battle: Stand with me. We hold this ground.
boss: A dark power bars the way. We shall face it together.
commander: For every home beyond these walls.
victory: Let the weary rest. We have earned this dawn.
defeat: Gather the wounded. Our road does not end here.
death: Carry on... for those who cannot.
package: Good provision for the miles ahead.
record: May this deed give others hope.

select: Imperfection has summoned its correction.
run_start: This world will learn a single purpose.
battle: Resistance is a flaw to be removed.
boss: Even your might will serve perfection.
defeat: This vessel requires correction.

select: The old roots remember their queen.
run_start: Let our scattered kin march as one.
battle: Blades forward. Leave no ally behind.
boss: We have faced monsters before. Hold the line.
commander: With me, children of the ancient wood.
victory: Our people will sing of this day.
defeat: We withdraw. We do not surrender.
package: A gift to strengthen every branch.

select: You have chosen a road with no return.
run_start: Come. Let us see what fate will yield.
battle: Your resolve is so easily divided.
boss: At last. Something worth the trouble.
commander: Look closely. This is the distance between us.
defeat: A brief interruption. Nothing more.
record: Even fate is learning to obey.

select: Beneath the rot, a thousand lives are waiting.
run_start: What is buried will walk beside us.
battle: Sink your roots into what remains.
boss: Even giants become nourishment.
commander: The deep earth gives back its dead.
victory: Where they fall, new life will gather.
defeat: The soil will keep us until we rise.
package: Nothing is wasted in my keeping.

select: If you seek a quiet road, choose someone else.
run_start: I will not leave another home in ashes.
battle: Wings above. Strike with me.
boss: I have hunted worse things than you.
commander: Heaven or hell, answer my call.
victory: One less terror in the sky.
defeat: We lived. That is enough to begin again.
death: I could not... save them all.
package: Power is a tool. I will decide its purpose.
record: Let the vast remember who stood against it.
